svg.title: Choosing trajectories for training
svg.metadata: Embedded Lato Regular and Semibold subsets, renamed Rejection Diagram. Copyright (c) 2010-2011, Łukasz Dziedzic. Licensed under SIL OFL 1.1; see LICENSE-Lato.txt.
svg.desc: Four qualitative quadrants of task difficulty and model performance. Quadrant I: hard tasks with good performance, prioritize for training. Quadrant II: easy tasks with good performance, lower learning priority. Quadrant III: easy tasks with poor performance, downweight or reject. Quadrant IV: hard tasks with poor performance, inspect verified partial reasoning.
svg.text: Qualitative axes · Center = typical difficulty and performance
